references.text: The glory of the Lord appeared at the tabernacle when the congregation gathered against Moses and Aaron, just as here
Korah's rebellion also led to the glory of the Lord appearing before the entire congregation at the tabernacle
The cloud covered the tabernacle, and the glory of the Lord appeared when the people gathered against Moses and Aaron
The glory of the Lord appeared in the cloud, a recurring sign of God's presence
The cloud covered the tabernacle, and the glory of the Lord filled it, paralleling the cloud that covers the tent of meeting here
The glory of the Lord appeared before all the people at the tabernacle
The Lord came down in the pillar of cloud to the entrance of the tent of meeting
The cloud filled the house of the Lord so that the priests could not stand to minister, for the glory of the Lord filled the house
